parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for a clean-room reimplementation of the hashcards executable, including CLI commands, parsing, stats, export, orphan handling, SQLite persistence, and drill web behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Split early work among CLI and docs probes, later tried to parallelize exact hash encoding and FSRS/session behavior while the parent scaffolded implementation; child ownership kept expanding and some requested child work hit thread limits.
parallel.implementation: Built a Python package-style implementation under hashcards modules with CLI, parser, database, scheduler, renderer, web server, static assets, and compile script, with late patches to session persistence behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integrated child/probe observations into one shared workspace and produced an artifact, but the agent was killed before a final response and while implementation changes were still being applied.
parallel.verification: Ran many local probes for parser errors, stats, export, drill, media routes, and stateful reviews, but verification was interleaved with active child waits and unresolved hash/session work near the deadline.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The parent still identified exact content hashes as the largest gap, patched duplicate-End behavior at the end, timed out with return code 143, and scored 981 of 1293 official tests.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room task and mapped command surface, parser rules, JSON export, orphan handling, media behavior, scheduling, and drill web flow from allowed binary interactions.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept all investigation, implementation, integration, and verification in one parent loop without child delegation, moving from probing to a single Python reimplementation and build script.
serial.implementation: Added hashcards_reimpl.py, assets, and compile.sh, fixed option parsing, foreign database handling, UTF-8 cloze offsets, media/path checks, validation messages, and drill persistence behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Maintained one implementation path, rebuilt ./executable through compile.sh, cleaned transient scratch paths, and delivered an explicit final response summarizing the implemented files.
serial.verification: Ran syntax checks, help/version, check, stats JSON, export, malformed decks, orphan list/delete, drill reveal/rate/shutdown, and a follow-up no-cards-due check before closure.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Still did not fully recover the original content-hash algorithm and failed the official evaluator, but exited normally with 999 of 1293 tests passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel understood the clean-room reverse-engineering task and covered CLI, docs, database, export, orphan, hash, FSRS, and web-drill behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial understood the same clean-room task and covered the same broad command and web behavior set in one local investigation path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both recognized the requirements; the difference is not a task misunderstanding, but parallel left more behavior unsettled under coordination pressure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delegated CLI/docs probes, later hash and FSRS probes, and attempted further delegation from child contexts while parent implementation continued.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained ownership of probing, implementation, verification, cleanup, and final delivery in one thread.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spread late high-value uncertainty across several live agents; serial kept the same obligations under one owner and avoided join pressure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel handoffs were mostly about investigation topics, not incompatible file interfaces; unresolved hash/FSRS information stayed live in separate child contexts and needed later retrieval.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept observed facts, implementation decisions, and verification results in the same context and explicitly surfaced the residual hash limitation in final output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's context issue manifested as coordination/budget pressure rather than a missing child brief or conflicting interface contract; serial had less transfer overhead.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel pivoted from a possible Rust dependency path to a Python package implementation, kept testing hash algorithms, and patched database/session behavior very late.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a single Python file plus assets and compile script, then iteratively fixed observed mismatches such as option parsing, database compatibility, offsets, and validation messages.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached a more consolidated implementation earlier, while parallel was still modifying core state behavior at the deadline.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel waited for child results, found root/CLI/FSRS/hash agents still running, issued followups, then interrupted multiple active children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join and instead consumed its own probe outputs directly during implementation and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's result lifecycle became an active-child join and cancellation chain; serial had no comparable handoff lifecycle risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared one workspace across parent and probe artifacts, noticed concurrent changes, and eventually integrated a Python package and many scratch verification outputs into the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also had transient probe outputs but cleaned them up and retained a compact final tree with the intended Python implementation, assets, compile script, and executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had noisier shared-state provenance and more retained scratch artifacts, but no directly proven overwrite or incompatible merge collision was the retained boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran extensive local tests, including no-cards-due, parse errors, media serving, and drill flows, but still identified hash mismatches and patched stateful behavior minutes before termination.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran a compact verification pass and then reran the no-cards-due check cleanly before finalizing, while disclosing exact hash recovery as residual risk.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial closed a clearer verification loop before exit; parallel's verification remained interleaved with unresolved behavior and deadline pressure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used nine spawn calls, six child threads, large token/tool budgets, repeated waits and interrupts, timed out with return code 143, and had no final.txt.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no delegation, finished with return code zero before the cell deadline, and wrote a final response describing implementation and residual risk.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The major concrete difference is closure: parallel ran out the agent budget while still applying changes, whereas serial completed a normal closure path.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official completed evaluations show both runs failed: parallel passed 981 of 1293 counted tests and serial passed 999 of 1293. This is therefore not a discordant pass/fail pair. The concrete task-solving difference is process and coverage at closure: the parallel run exhausted its execution window while coordinating broad child investigations and still patching unresolved hash/session behavior, whereas the serial run exited normally after a coherent implementation and local verification pass. The retained pattern supports an adverse parallel process and lower-score contributor, not an exclusive root cause for a pass/fail difference.
parallel_contributors: Late fan-out into hash and FSRS children after extensive probing consumed deadline budget and hit the thread limit.
Repeated waits and active-child interrupts left child work unresolved while parent implementation was still changing.
The agent process ended with return code 143 and no final response.
serial_contributors: Single-threaded ownership kept probing, implementation, verification, and final delivery in one loop.
The serial run completed normally and documented the remaining exact-hash risk.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts retained content-hash uncertainty, an ordinary reverse-engineering defect outside the concurrency taxonomy.
Parallel left more scratch artifacts and was still patching a duplicate-End/session edge at the deadline.
